title: NAVIG Unified Answer
description: The one response contract every NAVIG surface renders. Produced once by a tool/router, rendered per surface (CLI, JSON, Alexa, Alice, OpenAI, deck, Telegram). schema_version pins the version; a breaking field change bumps it.

schema_version.description: Wire-contract version. Always "1" for this document.

ok.description: Did the action answer successfully? A failed answer still carries speech and data.error/hint.

speech.description: What TTS says (Alexa SSML / Alice tts are derived from this).

display_text.description: What a screen or transcript shows; falls back to speech when empty.

table.description: Optional tabular view for the CLI and the deck. One free-text column is expected at the end.

rows.description: Rows of string cells; every row has exactly one cell per column.

json.description: Machine payload. Omitted/null means 'use data' (Answer.as_dict fills it from data).

directives.description: Typed client actions a surface may perform. Unknown types are dropped, never guessed.

suggestions.description: Follow-up actions: Alexa reprompt, Alice buttons (max 5), Telegram buttons, OpenAI metadata.

data.description: Structured facts. A failed answer carries error and hint here so every surface can explain the next step.

plan.description: Plan metadata from the NAVIG Reflex: tool, target(s), blast radius, commit_token.

intent.description: The intent that produced this answer (e.g. home.off, endpoints.list).
